steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: assert-left-rail
steps.eval: (() => { const ps = document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const left = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ps).left); if (!(left > 100)) throw new Error('plan-screen left not shrunk: ' + left); return left; })()

steps.name: assert-mobile-left-zero
steps.eval: (() => { const ps = document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const left = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ps).left); if (left !== 0) throw new Error('mobile plan-screen left should be 0, got ' + left); return 'ok'; })()
